Main passes customers::createCustomer as an IntFunction. CustomerFactory does not implement IntFunction, so there is no realization arrow between them. The controller stores the function, not a concrete CustomerFactory.

Default seed 24369: Regular, VIP, Regular, Regular, Regular, Critic; six arrivals at 1/4/7/10/13/16. Regular/VIP cycle through the six orderable items; Critic chooses the most prep units, first tie. Happy Hour starts once, covers the current and next turn, and restores 15 waiting satisfaction at each opening (cap 100). Bills lock VIP then Happy Hour discounts when taken.
